plan.summary: BRO-4956: complete and correct the four West End openings of 7-9 Oct 2026 (Blood of my Blood, An Oak Tree, Rent, From The Heart) against the Best of Theatre / BroadwayWorld round-ups, plus one cousin found by the collision sweep (The Children, The Times). The Time Out carry-forward and the playwright quote page on An Oak Tree drop out through the guards landed with this plan.
